title: [IMP-09] Set up PPAP templates and their requirement matrix

Source plan

Task ID
IMP-09

Title
Set up PPAP templates and their requirement matrix

Category
Template configuration

Objective
Let administrators define which requirements and date rules apply to each PPAP type.

Detailed scope
Create Template and Template Requirement authoring/version fields and ordinary forms. Enter approved SIA template rows with one stable requirement per template, classification triggers, protected applicability, schedule phase and calendar offset.

Deliverable
Template authoring and published forms with an explicit governed requirement matrix.

Work needed first
IMP-01 — Create the PPAP Objects and workflow stages
IMP-02 — Set up PPAP reference lists and operating settings
IMP-07 — Set up the governed requirement library

What the earlier tasks provide
• IMP-01 provides the new Objects, native stage/termination identities and target-record marker.
• IMP-02 provides the seven governed lists and operating-policy fields/default entries.
• IMP-07 provides the requirement/question authoring and version fields/forms.

What is waiting
Partly waiting: the template/matrix fields and ordinary forms can proceed; source-backed SIA templates and row values wait for the requested matrix.

Recommended implementer role
Senior Associate Consultant

Recommended reviewer/approver role
Senior Consultant — PPAP build reviewer (a different person)

Why this role is recommended
The assignment combines established field, related-list and form settings. A Senior Associate Consultant can apply the conditions consistently, with the separate build reviewer checking their effect on the wider process.

Fields and features to set up
PPAP Template.Code
Set the type to Text; up to 100 characters; unique stable authoring key. Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: None. Who can use it and when: Configuration administrator; fixed after first Publish. Field/control lifecycle: Publish copies PPAP Template.Code to PPAP Template Version.Code; editing author does not change existing versions.

PPAP Template.Name
Set the type to Text; up to 255 characters; localizable. Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: None. Who can use it and when: PPAP configuration administrator before Publish. Field/control lifecycle: Publish copies PPAP Template.Name to PPAP Template Version.Name; editing author does not change existing versions.

PPAP Template.Type
Create a link to PPAP Type, selecting exactly one target record (M:1; many source records may select it). Keep its inverse disabled. Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: None. Who can use it and when: Configuration administrator; new selection Active?=TRUE; preserve inactive existing reference. Field/control lifecycle: Publish copies PPAP Template.Type to PPAP Template Version.Type; editing author does not change existing versions.

PPAP Template.Source Procedure Reference
Set the type to Text; up to 1000 characters. Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: None. Who can use it and when: PPAP configuration administrator before Publish. Field/control lifecycle: Publish copies PPAP Template.Source Procedure Reference to PPAP Template Version.Source Procedure Reference; editing author does not change existing versions.

PPAP Template.Active?
Set the type to Yes/No (Boolean). Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: TRUE. Who can use it and when: Configuration administrator. Field/control lifecycle: Controls new selection and Publish; not copied because Template Version.Active? is publication managed; existing issued work unchanged.

PPAP Template Version.Code
Set the type to Text; up to 100 characters; copied stable authoring key; not unique across versions. Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: Stored default-value copy from PPAP Template.Code at Publish. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly; fixed after successful Publish. Field/control lifecycle: Publish PPAP Template creates this value once; no continuing calculation.

PPAP Template Version.Name
Set the type to Text; up to 255 characters; localizable. Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: Stored default-value copy from PPAP Template.Name at Publish. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly; fixed after successful Publish. Field/control lifecycle: Publish PPAP Template creates this value once; no continuing calculation.

Create a link to PPAP Type, selecting exactly one target record (M:1; many source records may select it). Keep its inverse disabled. Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: Stored default-value copy from PPAP Template.Type at Publish. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly; fixed after successful Publish; no manual selection; Publish validates Active?=TRUE at resolution, then preserves copied reference if later inactive. Field/control lifecycle: Publish PPAP Template creates this value once; no continuing calculation.

PPAP Template Version.Authoring Record
Create a link to PPAP Template, selecting exactly one target record (M:1; many source records may select it). Enable the reverse read-only list PPAP Template.Versions. Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly. Field/control lifecycle: Publish PPAP Template retains stable source; authoring record cannot be deleted after use.

PPAP Template Version.Version Number
Set the type to a whole number (Integer/Int32). Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: Maximum related Versions.Version Number + 1; first 1. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly. Field/control lifecycle: Publish serializes by authoring identity; enforce unique Authoring Record+Version Number.

PPAP Template Version.Active?
Set the type to Yes/No (Boolean). Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: TRUE on successful Publish. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly. Field/control lifecycle: Publish atomically deactivates older versions of same author; no ordinary user edit; inactive version remains valid for existing PPAP.

PPAP Template Version.Published At
Set the type to Date/Time; time-zone support enabled; store UTC, display user zone. Optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly. Field/control lifecycle: Publish PPAP Template stamps server timestamp after full graph validation.

Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly. Field/control lifecycle: Publish PPAP Template writes actual authenticated administrator.

PPAP Template.Versions
Create a read-only related-record list over PPAP Template Version.Authoring Record; one owning record can show many linked entries (inverse 1:M). Store no second link. Optional navigation only. Apply the owning-record and file permissions; make the list read only and populate it only through the declaring link, with no separate stored value.

Build instructions
1. Use one authoring Template Requirement row per Template+stable Requirement. Keep its Requirement link to the stable authoring record; the publication action resolves and saves the exact version. Prevent duplicate row identity.
2. Show Always Applicable?, On Important Safety?, On Important Quality? and On Regulated? as separate fields. A row applies when Always is TRUE, or any enabled classification trigger matches any included part. Combine applicable rows into one requirement set, with no duplicate requirement.
3. Enter the supplied approved templates and matrix values only. Protect the mandatory SIA data-review requirement and every other source-mandated/classification requirement; do not guess which OOTB entries satisfy them. Keep authoring and published Code uniqueness scoped correctly across versions.

How to check the result
• One template cannot contain two authoring rows for the same governed requirement.
• Safety/quality/regulated triggers are independently represented and combine by the stated OR rule; published rows are read only.

Information needed for this task
IN-01: Supply the actual template Codes/Names/types/procedure references and every requirement row with Always/Safety/Quality/Regulated triggers, protection, phase, offset and order. Structures can proceed; row values remain waiting.

Supplied input context
• IN-01 — Client PPAP library and procedure: The client has been asked for the controlled SIA PPAP spreadsheet, procedure, IntelliQuest requirements/questions and template/classification matrix. They have not yet been supplied. Their exact content, protection rules, routing, dates and approved category/phase/stage/exception values are needed to complete the affected configuration; Objects and known controls can proceed.
